calculation.expression: (close / lag(close,60) - 1) / (abs(close / rolling_max(close,60) - 1) + 0.03), then demean by same-date cross-sectional median
calculation.description: Ranks trailing 60-day return after penalizing drawdown from the trailing 60-day peak; the cross-sectional median is subtracted to remove the common level. All inputs are lagged through the completed decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in the full sample and in reported 2020, 2023, 2025, and 2026-07 onward subperiods; uncertainty remains due to the 15-asset cross-section.
